name: Krishna Prasanth Sridhar
summary: AI Engineer and agentic-AI enthusiast, transitioning from front-end development to intelligent system design. Builds LLM agents that plan tasks, call real-world tools and APIs, search and reason over knowledge, and execute multi-step workflows. 3+ years of experience in React, Next.js, Angular, and GraphQL with a strong product-engineering background. Currently pursuing an M.S. in IT & Management at the Illinois Institute of Technology, specializing in Web design and application development.
